items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: that was a rhythm section like there's never been a rhythm section like That in a band before... Jo Jones and Walter Page and Basie was doing something else

ctx.x: He was out somewhere, and then finally he came in. And, I think they started playing something -- I don't know what it was. I think it was the blues they started playing, and I just started playing with them. I think Walter Page came over. And, it wasn't a big thing. I didn't know whether I got the job or not, really. You know, it wasn't anything real big, and I just knew -- you know, it was so abrupt until -- I just knew I didn't get it, you know. I just said "Oh, well, okay", you know. (laugh)
